title: Two-Dimensional Materials toward CMOS-Compatible Scalable Quantum Hardware
summary: Manufacturability is one of several constraints on developing solid-state quantum processors, along with qubit performance, control, connectivity, cryogenic operation, and fault tolerance. Chemical residues, structural disorder, and non-uniform interfaces introduced during fabrication can compromise qubit coherence. Two-dimensional (2D) materials, with their atomically thin crystals and van der Waals interfaces, offer routes to address some of these challenges. Their concurrent development as next-generation CMOS channel materials motivates an examination of whether relevant processes can be transferred to quantum chips. This Perspective evaluates the opportunities and limitations of 2D materials for CMOS-compatible quantum hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇Perspective，评估二维材料在CMOS兼容量子硬件中的应用前景与局限。
AI.motivation: 固态量子处理器开发受制于可制造性等多重约束，制造过程中的化学残留、结构无序和非均匀界面会削弱量子比特相干性。二维材料凭借原子级薄晶体和范德华界面，有望缓解这些问题，且其作为下一代CMOS沟道材料的研发进展，促使人们审视相关工艺能否迁移至量子芯片。
AI.method: 以Perspective形式，系统评估二维材料用于CMOS兼容量子硬件的机遇与限制。
AI.result: 指出二维材料可借助其独特结构特性应对部分制造挑战，并借助CMOS工艺兼容性探索向量子器件迁移的可能。
AI.conclusion: 二维材料为CMOS兼容量子硬件提供潜在路径，但仍需权衡其机遇与局限。

title: Breaking the Wiedemann-Franz limit in thermoelectrics via separated flat bands
summary: Controlling the charge and spin degrees of freedom of electrons in solids has been at the heart of condensed-matter science for centuries. One hallmark of metallic conduction is the Wiedemann-Franz law which implies that a moving charge carries entropy. Despite centuries of dedicated research, disentangling charge and heat transport has remained an unsolved issue so far. Here we present a direct route to reduce thermal conductivity of conduction electrons with respect to their electrical conductivity via energy-dependent scattering. By constraining electronic transport to a boxcar-type distribution asymmetrically around the Fermi energy, a large Seebeck coefficient and electrical conductivity can be realized simultaneously while electronic heat conduction is suppressed. Based on the case of monolayer Ni$_3$In, which comprises two flat bands around the Fermi energy, we propose flat-band systems as a promising, tunable platform for scattering phase space engineering. Besides this novel approach, our large-scale assessment of $\approx 5\times 10^4$ data sets in a 'Wiedemann-Franz plot' of $zT$ vs. $S^2$ provides an effective tool to identify reports of $L\ll L_0$ from literature - pointing towards either new and interesting physical mechanisms - or overlooked measurement artifacts.

AI.tldr: 该文提出通过能量依赖散射抑制电子热导，利用平带体系（单层Ni3In）实现高热电性能，并给出筛选非常规Wiedemann-Franz行为的数据工具。
AI.motivation: 电荷与热输运难以解耦，Wiedemann-Franz定律使金属中高电导必然带来高电子热导，限制了热电性能提升，长期未解。
AI.method: 通过能量依赖散射调控电子输运，使其在费米能附近呈不对称“箱车型”分布，从而同时获得大Seebeck系数与高电导并抑制电子热导；以含两条平带的单层Ni3In为例，提出平带体系作为散射相空间工程平台；对约5×10^4数据集的zT-S^2“Wiedemann-Franz图”进行大规模评估。
AI.result: 在单层Ni3In中可实现大S与高电导共存且电子热导被抑制；zT vs. S^2图可有效识别文献中L≪L0的报道，指向新物理机制或被忽视的测量假象。
AI.conclusion: 平带体系是调控散射相空间、解耦电与热输运的可调平台，Wiedemann-Franz图可作为甄别异常输运报道的实用工具。

title: Domain-wall energy governs coercivity in ordered and disordered additively manufactured Fe--49Co--2V
summary: Additively manufactured soft-magnetic Fe--Co is consistently harder than wrought material of the same composition, and controlling that excess is the central obstacle to printing electrical machines from these alloys. The literature attributes it to B2 chemical ordering, untested because the anisotropy of the ordered state had not been measured for this alloy and because printed material had never been compared with wrought material at matched grain size. In this study we supply both. Calibrating on wrought Fe--49Co--2V at a known order parameter fixes the ordered-state domain-wall energy and caps every pinning channel independent of grain size. Ordering then falls orders of magnitude short of the measured excess, and a tenfold change in antiphase-domain size leaves coercivity unchanged. What ordering controls is the wall energy, and that effect is small and bounded. The excess is retained defect content, which moves process optimization from post-build annealing to in-build defect control.

AI.tldr: 增材制造软磁Fe-Co比锻造材料更硬，本文证明其来源不是B2有序化，而是残余缺陷，需从后处理退火转向构建中的缺陷控制。
AI.motivation: 增材制造Fe-Co持续比同成分锻造材料更硬，是打印电机的核心障碍；文献通常归因于B2化学有序，但缺乏有序态各向异性测量和同晶粒尺寸下的对比验证。
AI.method: 以已知有序度的锻造Fe-49Co-2V标定有序态畴壁能，并封顶各钉扎通道；再对比锻造与打印材料、改变反相畴尺寸进行验证。
AI.result: 有序化效应远不足以解释测得的硬度超出；反相畴尺寸十倍变化对矫顽力无影响。有序化仅控制畴壁能，且效应小而有限。
AI.conclusion: 硬度超出源于保留下来的缺陷内容，因此工艺优化应从构建后退火转向构建过程中的缺陷控制。

title: Full Minimal Coupling All-Electron Real-Time TDDFT for X-Ray-Matter Interactions
summary: Standard real-time time-dependent density functional theory (RT-TDDFT) couples light to matter through a spatially uniform (dipole) vector potential, an approximation that breaks down in the X-ray regime, where the photon wavelength approaches interatomic scales. We present an all-electron, numeric-atom-centered-orbital implementation of full minimal coupling in FHI-aims that retains the spatial structure of the vector potential in both the paramagnetic and diamagnetic couplings, implements a reciprocal-space-resolved current diagnostic, and extends the propagation to periodic systems through a perturbative photon-momentum sideband coupling that recovers the density response at the photon wavevector. Four benchmarks ranging in energy from 100 eV to 5 keV validate the implementation and exercise its reach. The retained photon momentum proves physically consequential throughout, from measurable beyond dipole corrections to the enabling of channels forbidden in the dipole limit. On an all-electron footing, the implementation lays the groundwork for a general ab initio treatment of X-ray light-matter interaction across molecules, surfaces, and solids.

AI.tldr: 本文在FHI-aims中实现了全电子、原子中心数值轨道的完整最小耦合RT-TDDFT，保留矢量势空间结构，支持X射线光-物质相互作用。
AI.motivation: 标准RT-TDDFT使用空间均匀(偶极)矢量势近似，在X射线区失效，因光子波长接近原子间尺度。
AI.method: 在FHI-aims中实现全电子、原子中心数值轨道的完整最小耦合，保留顺磁和抗磁耦合中矢量势空间结构，实现倒空间分辨的电流诊断，并通过微扰光子动量边带耦合扩展到周期系统。
AI.result: 四个从100 eV到5 keV的基准测试验证了实现，光子动量保留在全程产生物理效应，从可测量的非偶极修正到偶极极限禁止的通道。
AI.conclusion: 该全电子实现为分子、表面和固体的X射线光-物质相互作用通用从头算处理奠定基础。

title: Maxwell-J$ü$ttner averaged nonaffine theory of relativistic shear viscosity
comment: 26 pages, 8 figures. Under review in Physical Review E. Comments are welcome
summary: We formulate a Maxwell-Jüttner averaged extension of relativistic nonaffine shear-viscosity theory for a classical gas of massive particles. The starting point is the relativistic nonaffine response formula derived from generalized Langevin dynamics, where proper-momentum dissipation produces a Lorentz-factor enhancement of the viscosity. Since a thermal relativistic gas is not characterized by a single Lorentz factor, we replace this scalar enhancement by an equilibrium momentum average over the Maxwell-Jüttner distribution. Within the scalar transverse mean-field closure used in this work, the minimal relativistic correction is the Maxwell-Jüttner mean of the Lorentz factor and becomes a finite-mass enhancement function of $ζ=mc^2/(k_BT)$. In the general closure, the averaged object is the full product of the Lorentz factor, the zero-frequency memory kernel, and the nonaffine affine-force correlator. This construction separates kinematic relativistic enhancement from dynamical dissipation encoded in the bath memory and collective mode spectrum. We derive the nonrelativistic and ultrarelativistic limits, show that a specified effective hard-sphere scaling reproduces the classical square-root law as a consistency test, and identify the assumptions under which a cubic high-temperature law follows. Comparison with relativistic kinetic-theory examples clarifies that the memory kernel is not equivalent to a relaxation time unless a microscopic closure is specified. Retaining the full frequency dependence instead yields a relaxation spectrum. A single dominant pole reduces this spectrum to one shear relaxation time and gives the usual transient shear equation.

AI.tldr: 本文将非仿射剪切黏度理论扩展到相对论情形，用Maxwell-Jüttner分布对Lorentz因子做动量平均，给出相对论黏度的修正与极限行为。
AI.motivation: 相对论非仿射响应公式中Lorentz因子增强黏度，但热相对论气体并非单一Lorentz因子，因此需对平衡动量分布做平均以得到合理修正。
AI.method: 从广义Langevin动力学导出的相对论非仿射响应公式出发；标量横向平均场闭合下，用Maxwell-Jüttner分布对Lorentz因子做均值，得到有限质量增强函数ζ=mc²/(k_BT)；一般闭合下平均对象为Lorentz因子、零频记忆核与非仿射仿射力关联子的乘积。
AI.result: 推导了非相对论与超相对论极限；指定有效硬球标度可重现经典平方根定律作为一致性检验；给出高温立方律成立的假设；明确记忆核仅在指定微观闭合时等价于弛豫时间，保留完整频率依赖得到弛豫谱，单主极点约化为一个剪切弛豫时间与瞬态剪切方程。
AI.conclusion: 该构造将相对论运动学增强与浴记忆和集体模谱的动力学耗散分离，为相对论非仿射剪切黏度提供了系统的平均化框架，并澄清记忆核与弛豫时间的关系。

title: Molecular representation shapes the balance between target fidelity and exploration in flow based polymer generation
summary: Designing polymers with targeted properties requires navigating vast chemical spaces from limited labeled data. Here we introduce PolyLatentFlow, a framework based on continuous-time flow matching in latent space for unconditional and conditional polymer generation, together with LlamaUni, a multimodal representation combining polymer sequence and 3D structural information. In unconditional generation, PolyLatentFlow with LlamaUni produced the largest yield of valid candidates novel relative to PolyInfo among the evaluated unconditional generators while maintaining high diversity. For $T_g$ conditioning, generated property distributions shifted systematically across a 200 °C target range. In multi-property tasks, molecular representations showed similar surrogate target fidelity but differed markedly in validity, training-set replay, and structural proximity to labeled polymers. PolyLatentFlow with LlamaUni consistently combined high validity with low replay and achieved the largest per-attempt yield of nonreplayed target hits for CO$_2$/N$_2$ conditioning. These results demonstrate latent space flow matching for polymer inverse design and identify molecular representation as a key determinant of target control and exploration beyond labeled chemistry.

AI.tldr: 提出PolyLatentFlow(潜空间连续时间流匹配用于聚合物生成)与LlamaUni(融合序列与3D结构的聚合物多模态表示),实现无条件和条件聚合物逆设计。
AI.motivation: 在有限标注数据下设计具有目标性质的聚合物,需在巨大化学空间中探索,现有方法在有效性、新颖性和目标控制方面存在不足。
AI.method: 基于潜空间连续时间流匹配的生成框架PolyLatentFlow,支持无条件与条件生成;并提出LlamaUni多模态聚合物表示,融合序列与3D结构信息。
AI.result: 无条件生成中,PolyLatentFlow+LlamaUni相对PolyInfo产生最多有效且新颖的候选并保持高多样性;Tg条件生成的性质分布可在200°C目标范围内系统性迁移;多性质任务中表示方法在有效性、训练集复现(replay)和结构邻近性上差异显著,PolyLatentFlow+LlamaUni在高有效性与低复现间取得平衡,并在CO2/N2条件生成中取得最高非复现目标命中率。
AI.conclusion: 验证了潜空间流匹配用于聚合物逆设计的可行性,并表明分子表示是决定目标控制能力与超越已有化学空间探索的关键因素。

title: Quantum Critical Solids
summary: We study the fate of quantum solids with a vanishing velocity of transverse phonons. Such ``floppy'' solids exhibit a cubic elastic nonlinearity that is relevant in spatial dimensions $d<4$ and drives the system to a strongly-coupled Lifshitz quantum critical point in $d=3$, that we analyze in an $ε= 4-d$ expansion. The associated phase transition is generically first-order, preempting the system's full access to the strongly-coupled fixed point. Nevertheless, the critical data of this quantum critical point is accessible within a Ginzburg region in the vicinity of the transition. This cubic nonlinearity vanishes exactly in $d=2$, where the leading interactions are instead quartic and are marginal, leading to weak logarithmic singularities. We discuss possible realizations of this ``crystal Lifshitz criticality'' in quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 研究横向声子速度消失的"软"量子固体，其三次弹性非线性在d<4时驱动系统进入d=3的强耦合Lifshitz量子临界点，并用ε=4-d展开分析。相变一般为一级，但临界数据可在Ginzburg区内获取；d=2时三次项消失，四次项边缘导致弱对数奇异。
AI.motivation: 探究横向声子速度为零的"软"量子固体的命运，理解其弹性非线性如何驱动量子相变，并寻找量子材料中的可能实现。
AI.method: 采用ε=4-d维展开，分析d=3时由三次弹性非线性驱动的强耦合Lifshitz量子临界点；并讨论d=2时四次边缘相互作用的情形。
AI.result: 相变一般为一级，抢先阻止系统完全到达强耦合不动点；但临界数据仍可在相变附近的Ginzburg区内获得。d=2时三次非线性恰好消失，主导的四次相互作用为边缘型，产生弱对数奇异。
AI.conclusion: 提出"晶体Lifshitz临界性"概念，并讨论其在量子材料中的可能实现。

title: Anderson localization in topological metals
summary: We address the question of whether topological metals (TM) retain their nontrivial characteristics in the presence of disorder. While in the clean case, the issue is what protects the gaplessness of the spectrum, i.e. the band-touching nodes in TM, this question needs to be reformulated in the presence of disorder. The concept of gaplessness loses its sharp meaning in this case, since spectral gaps can be filled in by disorder-induced states. What is still meaningful is entanglement: one may ask whether the long-range entanglement of the clean gapless TM survives in the presence of disorder or, in other words, whether nontrivial topology protects the TM from Anderson localization. We demonstrate that such a protection exists in the case of three-dimensional (3D) Weyl semimetals, but not in 2D and 3D (type-I) Dirac or 3D nodal line semimetals. We establish this by combining the idea of unquantized anomaly as the topological response of TM with the decorated domain wall construction, used previously to discuss average symmetry-protected topological insulating phases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无序下拓扑金属(TM)的非平凡特性是否保留，论证3D Weyl半金属中拓扑能保护其免于Anderson局域化，而2D/3D Dirac及3D nodal line半金属则不能。
AI.motivation: 干净TM中gapless性由能带接触节点保护，但存在无序时能隙概念模糊（被无序态填充），需重新表述为：干净TM的长程纠缠是否在无序下存活，即拓扑能否保护TM免于Anderson局域化。
AI.method: 结合非量子化anomaly作为TM拓扑响应的思想，与decorated domain wall构造（此前用于讨论平均对称保护拓扑绝缘相）。
AI.result: 3D Weyl半金属中存在此保护；2D和3D(type-I) Dirac半金属及3D nodal line半金属中不存在。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑保护无序下的稳定性依赖于TM的具体类型，Weyl半金属具有特殊性。

title: Topological superconductors and Majorana fermions based on $X$-wave magnets with $X=p,d,f,g,i $
summary: We study superconductors coupled with $X$-wave magnets with $X=p,d,f,g,i$. They are essentially different between altermagnets with $X=d,g,i$ and odd-parity magnets $X=p,f$ due to the compatibility of the spin-singlet formation of the $s$-wave superconductor. The altermagnets and odd-parity magnets show rich superconducting phase diagrams depending on the strength of the magnetic order, the chemical potential and the ratio of the on-site and nearest-neighbor interactions. Especially, we find that the altermagnetic order stabilizes the chiral ($p_{x}+ip_{y}$)-wave superconductor, which is a class D topological superconductor hosting Majorana chiral edge states. It is characterized by the Chern number. Especially, there emerge two chiral edge modes in the $i$-wave altermagnet, which are characterized by the Chern number 2. On the other hand, the $p$ ($f$)-wave odd-parity magnetic order stabilizes the $p$ ($f$)-wave topological superconductor, which is a class DIII topological superconductor hosting Majorana flat bands. It is characterized by the winding number. Majorana flat bands are robust in the presence of the mixing with the $s$-wave superconductivity, which is inevitable for odd-parity magnets although the magnitude of the mixing is tiny.

AI.tldr: 研究s波超导体与X波磁性(p,d,f,g,i)的耦合，区分交错磁(d,g,i)与奇宇称磁(p,f)两类，发现丰富的超导相图及拓扑超导态。
AI.motivation: 探究不同对称性的磁性序(X波磁体)如何与常规s波超导耦合，从而产生各类拓扑超导体及马约拉纳边缘态。
AI.method: 基于s波超导体与X波磁体耦合模型，分析磁性序强度、化学势以及在位与近邻相互作用比值的依赖关系，按交错磁(d,g,i)与奇宇称磁(p,f)分类研究相图。
AI.result: 交错磁序稳定手性(p_x+ip_y)波超导，属D类拓扑超导，具手性马约拉纳边缘态(以陈数刻画)；i波交错磁中出现陈数为2的两个手性边缘模。p(f)波奇宇称磁序稳定p(f)波拓扑超导，属DIII类，具马约拉纳平带(以绕数刻画)。
AI.conclusion: 交错磁与奇宇称磁因自旋单重态相容性不同而表现迥异，分别产生D类和DIII类拓扑超导；马约拉纳平带在s波混合下依然稳健。

title: A Gradient-Reconstruction Lattice Boltzmann Method for Compressible Navier--Stokes--Fourier Equations
summary: Reaching compressible flow has usually forced lattice Boltzmann methods to abandon the compact stencil or the strict locality that make them efficient. We give up neither, solving the compressible Navier--Stokes--Fourier equations with a scheme that transports only the conserved mass, momentum and energy. The viscous stress and heat flux depend on gradients of the velocity and temperature. To capture them, existing compressible schemes go beyond a single lattice of the conserved fields. They enlarge the velocity set, carry the stress and heat flux as extra transported fields, place the energy on a separate grid, or give up exact streaming for an off-lattice advection. We instead recover the gradients from the non-equilibrium part of the distributions already present, inside the collision. No field beyond the conserved state is transported, no neighbour is read, streaming stays exact, and every computation runs in single precision. The method carries five fields where a transported-flux scheme carries fourteen, at a fraction of the memory and $4.9$ times the throughput. Verified against the exact Sod and Becker shock solutions and a supersonic Taylor--Green vortex, it tracks the direct-numerical-simulation reference on the kinetic energy and stays within the reference-solver spread on both dissipation rates.

AI.tldr: 提出一种格子Boltzmann方法，仅输运守恒的质量、动量和能量场，在碰撞过程中从分布函数的非平衡部分恢复速度与温度梯度，从而在不扩大模板、不增加输运场、保持精确迁移和单精度的前提下求解可压缩NSF方程。
AI.motivation: 可压缩流动通常迫使LBM放弃紧凑模板或严格局部性，从而牺牲其效率。现有可压缩方案需要扩大速度集、输运应力/热通量额外场、单独网格放置能量或改用离格对流。作者希望同时保留紧凑模板与严格局部性。
AI.method: 方案仅输运守恒的质量、动量与能量五个场。粘性应力和热通量依赖速度与温度的梯度，作者改为在碰撞算子内部，从已有分布函数的非平衡部分恢复这些梯度。因此不输运任何额外场、不读取邻居、迁移保持精确，且全部计算可用单精度完成。
AI.result: 与输运通量方案（需14个场）相比，本方法只需5个场，内存大幅降低，吞吐量提升4.9倍。用精确的Sod、Becker激波解及超音速Taylor–Green涡验证，动能上能跟踪DNS参考，两种耗散率均处于参考求解器散布范围内。
AI.conclusion: 该方案证明可在不放弃紧凑模板与局部性的前提下求解可压缩Navier–Stokes–Fourier方程，兼顾效率、内存与精度，适用于可压缩流动模拟。

title: Scaling LLM Agents for Materials Design through Hierarchical Collective Reasoning
summary: Materials design must reconcile competing functional requirements with stability and synthesis constraints. Generative models can produce stable, novel crystals, but accommodating detailed natural-language design instructions remains challenging. Here we introduce HiMatGen, a framework for scaling large language model agents through hierarchical collective reasoning. Built from GPT-5.6 Terra, HiMatGen connects 100 investigators in discussion pods across ten scientific domains with tool-enabled domain representatives. Representatives investigate proposals, exchange evidence across domains and return findings and unresolved questions to their pods. This bidirectional exchange turns specialist disagreements into structural revisions and alternative designs. Across six chemical systems, HiMatGen produces 1.9 times as many final crystal candidates and 1.7 times as many stable, unique and novel (SUN) structures as a tool-enabled GPT-6 Astra single-agent baseline. In property-directed tasks, the complete HiMatGen workflow outperforms same-model single-agent and independent-generation controls. Comparisons with MatterGen and Chemeleon2 demonstrate its ability to develop diverse crystals satisfying joint functional and chemical requirements. In a paired comparison initialized from the same proposals, hierarchical discussion reduces debate-stage token usage by a factor of 22 relative to full debate. HiMatGen provides an approach to materials design that sustains the exchange of scientific knowledge and computational evidence throughout iterative exploration as the agent population grows.

AI.tldr: HiMatGen 提出通过分层集体推理扩展大语言模型智能体，用于材料设计，生成更多稳定、新颖且满足功能需求的晶体。
AI.motivation: 材料设计需平衡功能需求、稳定性与合成约束；生成模型虽能产生稳定新晶体，但难以遵循详细自然语言设计指令。
AI.method: 基于 GPT-5.6 Terra 构建 HiMatGen，将 100 名研究者组织为讨论小组，覆盖十个科学领域，并连接具备工具能力的领域代表；代表跨领域调查、交换证据并返回发现与未解决问题，通过双向交流将专家分歧转化为结构修订和替代设计。
AI.result: 在六个化学体系中，最终晶体候选数量为工具增强 GPT-6 Astra 单智能体基线的 1.9 倍，稳定、唯一且新颖（SUN）结构为 1.7 倍；在性质导向任务中优于同模型单智能体与独立生成控制组；相比 MatterGen 和 Chemeleon2，可生成满足联合功能与化学需求的多样晶体；分层讨论使辩论阶段 token 使用量降低 22 倍。
AI.conclusion: HiMatGen 提供了一种随智能体规模增长仍能持续交换科学知识与计算证据的材料设计方法。

title: Hidden kinetic correlations control collective phases of entropy-conditioned histories
summary: Visible dynamics and mean dissipation need not determine the collective phases of rare histories. We construct local Markov models with identical ordinary visible path distributions, stationary states, mean entropy production, mean jump activity and driving affinities, yet different phases when histories are weighted by their full entropy production. Visible configurations modulate hidden driven cycles, whose exact elimination turns kinetic correlations into interactions. A positive spectral reduction separates hidden relaxation from collective modes. Periodic binary models retain opposite phases with entropy variances matched at every observation time. For conserved particles, a pair matches the first two joint cumulants of entropy and hidden activity at every observation time, yet selects segregation or a fluctuating state with suppressed long-wavelength density noise. Bound-state transport and fermionic evolution determine their contrasting dynamics. At a clean Ising critical midpoint, the entropy source couples quadratically to the thermal perturbation, making the fourth cumulant the first to detect the critical susceptibility. Its rate per site grows logarithmically, with an exact cutoff set by system size and observation time. For two quenched disorder ensembles, exact sample-response formulas and numerical evidence support a finite fourth-cumulant density despite very slow relaxation; a weak-disorder continuum response admits a controlled Borel sum. A common positive hidden eigenvector characterizes autonomous selected dynamics. When this condition fails, a finite network develops visible memory while preserving its ordinary visible process and mean diagnostics. These results identify kinetic information missed by aggregate thermodynamic observations.

AI.tldr: 可见动力学与平均耗散无法确定稀有历史的集体相。作者构造局部马尔可夫模型，其可见路径分布、稳态、平均熵产生等常规诊断量完全相同，但按完整熵产生加权历史时呈现不同相。
AI.motivation: 通常用平均熵产生、跳变活动等热力学总量来刻画系统的集体行为，但本文指出这些聚合观测会遗漏关键的动力学信息，从而无法区分历史加权下的不同相。
AI.method: 构造局部马尔可夫模型：通过消去隐藏驱动循环，把动能关联转化为有效相互作用；利用正谱约化分离隐藏弛豫与集体模式；对周期二元模型、守恒粒子对、Ising临界点、淬火无序系综及有限网络分别做精确求解与数值分析。
AI.result: 周期二元模型保持相反相且熵方差在每个观测时刻匹配；守恒粒子对匹配熵与隐藏活动的前两阶联合累积量，却选择偏析或长波密度噪声被抑制的涨落态；Ising临界中点熵源与热扰动二次耦合，第四阶累积量最先探测临界磁化率，其每格点速率对数增长并有精确截断；两种淬火无序系综下第四累积量密度有限，弱无序连续响应可做受控Borel求和。
AI.conclusion: 由共同正隐藏特征向量刻画的动力学是自主选择相的特征；当该条件失效时，有限网络会出现可见记忆，同时保持普通可见过程与平均诊断量不变。这些结果揭示了被聚合热力学观测遗漏的动力学信息，即“动能信息”。

title: Multi-Task Graph Neural Network Predictions of Auger-Electron and X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy
summary: Auger-electron spectroscopy has long accompanied x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy as a second modality to resolve chemical states with overlapping core-electron binding energies. However, analyzing the Auger spectrum is challenged by its complexity and the computational expense of its simulation. Here we demonstrate that the physical connection, and thus inter-task relationship, between the generation of a core-hole and its corresponding Auger-Meitner decay enables inductive knowledge transfer through the training of a multi-task graph neural network to predict both observables from a common graph embedding. Both task losses are combined with learned weights via the uncertainty weighting procedure. Overall, the single-task and multi-task models predict calculated and experimental Auger lineshapes with good accuracy in most cases. The performance between the two task regimes is similar, with the single-task models generally having better predictions of the finer peak structures in the spectrum. The present results demonstrate that multi-task training is a promising avenue for future developments of universal x-ray spectroscopy models with learned representations that map the molecular structure to a multitude of techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文训练多任务图神经网络，从共享图嵌入同时预测core-hole生成与Auger-Meitner衰减，实现知识迁移，用于解析复杂的Auger谱。
AI.motivation: Auger电子谱是X射线光电子谱的重要补充，可分辨core-electron结合能重叠的化学态，但其谱图复杂、模拟计算成本高，难以分析。
AI.method: 利用core-hole生成与Auger-Meitner衰减之间的物理关联（任务间关系），训练多任务图神经网络从共同图嵌入预测两个观测量；两个任务损失通过不确定性加权（uncertainty weighting）以学习权重结合。
AI.result: 单任务与多任务模型在多数情况下都能较准确预测计算与实验Auger谱线形；两种任务机制性能相近，单任务模型对谱中更精细的峰结构预测通常更好。
AI.conclusion: 多任务训练是发展通用X射线谱学模型的有前景方向，可学习将分子结构映射到多种技术的表示。

title: Analytical solutions to the non-equilibrium Green's functions in large-$q$ SYK models
summary: It is known that the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model is exactly solvable at leading order in $1/q$; specifically, the instantaneously thermal time block after the quench is known in closed form. Thus far the remaining (inherently out of equilibrium) blocks have only been numerically accessible. Here we provide their analytical solutions for a quench between non-commuting $q/2$-body SYK Hamiltonians. We obtain the Green's functions in closed form for every time block. We extract a simple relation between the pre- and post-quench energies $ε_1 \propto ε_0$ leading to an exact temperature update rule. Via a Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, we show that heating is inevitable for the closed system; hence, the second law emerges geometrically. The solution is used in a companion paper to address what ``instantaneous thermalization'' means at finite $q$.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了非对易 q/2-body SYK 哈密顿量淬火后所有时间区块格林函数及预/后淬火能量的解析解。
AI.motivation: SYK 模型仅在 1/q 领头阶可解，淬火后瞬时热化的时间区块已知闭式解，但其余（本质非平衡）区块此前只能数值求解。
AI.method: 解析求解非对易 q/2-body SYK 哈密顿量之间的淬火，推导每个时间区块的闭式格林函数，并用 Cauchy-Schwarz 不等式分析加热。
AI.result: 获得所有时间区块的闭式格林函数，发现淬火前后能量满足 ε1 ∝ ε0 的关系，导出精确温度更新规则；证明封闭系统中加热不可避免。
AI.conclusion: 第二定律在此模型中几何性地涌现；该解被用于配套论文中探讨有限 q 下"瞬时热化"的含义。

title: An improved auxiliary boson method for quantum dots with finite Coulomb interaction U
summary: In this work, we present an improved version of the formulation of the four auxiliary bosons originally proposed by Kotliar and Ruckenstein, adapted to describe a quantum dot in the Kondo regime with finite electron-electron interaction U. The proposed refinement provides a more accurate treatment of strong electronic correlations while preserving the analytical tractability of the original approach, thereby enabling a reliable description of transport properties in nanoscale systems. Benchmark calculations show good agreement with the results of the numerical renormalization group, supporting the validity of the improved formulation. Our approach therefore provides an efficient and robust framework for investigating transport through strongly correlated quantum dots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出改进的Kotliar-Ruckenstein四辅助玻色子方法，用于描述有限U下Kondo区量子点的强关联与输运性质。
AI.motivation: 原Kotliar-Ruckenstein方法对强电子关联处理不够精确，需改进以可靠描述纳米尺度量子点输运。
AI.method: 在Kotliar-Ruckenstein四辅助玻色子表述基础上进行改进，保留解析可处理性，更准确处理强电子关联，并针对有限电子-电子相互作用U的Kondo区量子点建模。
AI.result: 基准计算与数值重整化群(NRG)结果吻合良好，验证了改进方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该改进框架高效、稳健，可用于研究强关联量子点的输运性质。

title: Optical and magnetic signatures of drive-enhanced coherence in phase-disordered superconducting bilayers
comment: Main: 6 pages, 4 figures; Supplement: 6 pages, 6 figures
summary: Recent experiments demonstrating superconducting-like characteristics in materials above their equilibrium transition temperatures following strong sub-picosecond optical excitation have stimulated theoretical interest in phase-disordered superconductors subject to a periodically modulated superfluid stiffness. Previous analyses of the single-layer optical conductivity have shown that such a drive can enhance the low-frequency $1/ω$ response, even when the period-averaged stiffness remains unchanged. We extend these studies to bilayer systems, such as the YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{6+x}$ (YBCO) cuprate, by considering drives with different symmetries. Specifically, we investigate a layer-symmetric drive, in which the two planes stiffen and soften simultaneously, and a layer-antisymmetric drive, in which one plane stiffens while the other softens. Both drives enhance correlations of the layer-averaged phase and generate comparable superconducting-like optical conductivities. Only the symmetric drive, however, strengthens relative-phase locking and the associated counterflow response to a magnetic field parallel to the planes. Thus, an enhanced $1/ω$ optical conductivity does not by itself imply enhanced magnetic screening. In view of applications to driven YBCO, where superconducting-like in-plane optics and transient diamagnetism have both been reported, our result provides a symmetry diagnostic: within a phase-synchronization mechanism, the experimentally active low-frequency stiffness modulation must contain a substantial layer-symmetric component.

AI.tldr: 本文将相位无序超导体受周期性调制超流刚度驱动的研究从单层推广到双层体系，发现对称与反对称驱动都能增强低频1/ω光学响应和层平均相位关联，但只有对称驱动能增强相对相位锁定和抗磁屏蔽，从而为驱动YBCO实验提供对称性判据。
AI.motivation: 实验中观察到强亚皮秒光激发下材料在其平衡转变温度以上出现类超导特性，已有单层理论表明周期调制超流刚度可增强低频1/ω响应，但对双层体系（如YBCO铜氧化物）及不同驱动对称性的作用尚不清楚，尤其是光学响应与磁屏蔽之间的关系需要厘清。
AI.method: 将单层光学电导率分析推广到双层系统，考虑两种驱动：层对称驱动（两平面同时变硬/变软）和层反对称驱动（一平面变硬另一平面变软），分别计算它们对层平均相位关联、相对相位锁定以及平行于平面的磁场下的逆流响应的影响。
AI.result: 两种驱动都能增强层平均相位关联，并产生相当的类超导光学电导率；但只有对称驱动能增强相对相位锁定及相应的平行磁场下的逆流响应。这表明增强的1/ω光学电导率本身并不必然意味着磁屏蔽的增强。
AI.conclusion: 针对驱动YBCO中同时报道的类超导面内光学响应和瞬态抗磁性，本文结果提供了一个对称性诊断：在相位同步机制下，实验中活跃的低频刚度调制必须包含显著的层对称分量。

title: Highly Parallel Real-Space Random Phase Approximation Using Lanczos Quadrature and Interpolation
summary: We present a highly parallelizable, matrix-free, real-space method for computing the random phase approximation (RPA) correlation energy within Kohn-Sham density functional theory. In particular, we avoid the explicit construction and eigen-decomposition of the response function matrix and use Lanczos quadrature to evaluate the trace of a matrix function on a real-space grid. We also show it is possible to exploit the spatial smoothness of the RPA correlation energy density in real-space to reduce computational cost. Specifically, we compute the energy density on a coarse grid, then reconstruct an approximation to the full, fine grid via interpolation. We implement this formulation within the SPARC electronic structure package and demonstrate its convergence, accuracy, agreement with planewave results, and scaling. Interpolation can enable an $8\times$ reduction in the computational prefactor. Given the embarrassingly parallel nature of the proposed method, we achieve near-ideal speedups and near-cubic scaling, thus allowing us to compute the RPA correlation energy for a silicon system with 256 valence electrons at chemical accuracy in less than 30 minutes on 4,096 CPU cores.

AI.tldr: 提出一种高度可并行、无矩阵的实空间方法计算Kohn-Sham DFT中的RPA关联能，避免响应函数矩阵的显式构造与特征分解，采用Lanczos求积评估矩阵函数迹，并利用实空间能量密度的空间平滑性在粗网格计算后插值重建细网格结果。
AI.motivation: RPA关联能计算通常需要显式构造和特征分解响应函数矩阵，计算成本高昂，难以扩展到大体系。
AI.method: 在实空间网格上使用无矩阵方法，通过Lanczos求积计算矩阵函数迹，避免响应矩阵的构造与对角化；并利用RPA关联能密度的空间平滑性，在粗网格上计算能量密度后经插值重建全细网格近似值。方法实现在SPARC电子结构软件包中。
AI.result: 验证了收敛性、精度、与平面波结果的一致性及扩展性；插值可带来约8倍计算前置因子降低；方法具高度并行性，实现近理想加速比和近立方扩展，在4096个CPU核心上30分钟内以化学精度完成256个价电子的硅体系RPA关联能计算。
AI.conclusion: 该无矩阵实空间方法结合Lanczos求积与网格插值，可高效、高精度地计算大体系RPA关联能，具备良好的并行扩展能力。

title: Symbolic Ensemble Learning Enables Discovery of Fast Accurate Physics-Based Interatomic Potentials
summary: Machine learning has transformed materials simulation by delivering force fields with ab initio accuracy, yet bridging the gap between high-dimensional regression and physical interpretability remains a grand challenge. Conventional analytical potentials offer transparency but often fail to capture the complexity of far-from-ground state regimes. Here, we introduce a hybrid symbolic-neural framework that unifies the interpretability of the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) with the adaptability of data-driven learning. Using Equation Learner Neural Networks (EqNNs) trained on density functional theory (DFT) data, we obtain interpretable models for aluminum through three distinct training protocols: random initialization trained via Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and gradient descent, and two transfer-learning strategies initialized from a copper potential - one employing MCTS followed by gradient descent, and the other using gradient descent only. We find that while all three resulting symbolic models achieve sub-10 meV/atom accuracy, they occupy distinct local minima in the functional landscape, exhibiting complementary trade-offs across phonon dispersion, surface energetics, and elastic response. By integrating these diverse functional forms through a weighted symbolic ensemble, we derive a composite potential that surpasses the fidelity of its constituent models. The resulting ensemble effectively mitigates individual biases, delivering superior consistency with DFT benchmarks across equation-of-state curvature, phonon spectra, and melting dynamics. This approach demonstrates that combining transfer learning with ensemble symbolic regression yields compact, transparent potentials capable of robust prediction across equilibrium and non-equilibrium states.

AI.tldr: 提出符号-神经混合框架，用EqNN在DFT数据上训练铝势，结合迁移学习与符号集成，得到兼具可解释性与高精度的势函数。
AI.motivation: 机器学习力场精度高但缺乏可解释性，传统解析势透明但难以描述远离基态的复杂区域，二者难以兼顾。
AI.method: 以EAM为符号基础，用Equation Learner神经网络在DFT数据上学习；对铝采用三种训练协议（随机初始化+MCTS+梯度下降，以及从铜势迁移学习的两种策略），并将多个符号模型加权集成为复合势。
AI.result: 三种符号模型均达到sub-10 meV/atom精度，但落在不同局部极小，在声子色散、表面能和弹性响应上各有取舍；加权集成后性能超过各单一模型，在状态方程曲率、声子谱和熔化动力学上更符合DFT基准。
AI.conclusion: 迁移学习与集成符号回归相结合可产生紧凑、透明的势函数，在平衡与非平衡态下均能稳健预测。

title: Unsupervised Machine Learning of the Contact Process
summary: We investigate how unsupervised machine-learning methods can characterize the active-absorbing phase transition in the contact process in one and two spatial dimensions. Our analysis focuses on principal component analysis (PCA) and variational autoencoders (VAEs), and we show that direct applications of these methods encounter a central difficulty: contact process configurations are intrinsically positive-definite. In the PCA case, standard centering procedures fail to isolate the order parameter in the leading component. To address this, we augment the data with sign-reversed configurations, creating a balanced dataset with zero mean while preserving the density information required to describe the transition. This preprocessing allows the dominant principal component to recover the order parameter and reproduce the expected finite-size scaling near criticality. For VAEs, we find a related limitation: a fixed Gaussian prior does not provide sufficient latent regularization across the full range of control parameters and system sizes for positive-definite data. We overcome this by adopting a heteroscedastic Gaussian prior that adapts to the control parameter, leading to a substantial improvement in the finite-size scaling of reconstruction-based observables near the critical threshold. Taken together, these results highlight a key lesson: the success of machine learning in phase-transition problems does not rely on algorithmic complexity alone, but on tailoring the representation to respect the physical structure of the system, including its intrinsic constraints and symmetries.

AI.tldr: 用无监督学习(PCA与VAE)研究接触过程相变时,数据固有的正定性带来困难;通过符号反转增强数据(去均值)和异方差高斯先验可恢复序参量与有限尺度标度。
AI.motivation: 探究无监督机器学习能否刻画一维和二维接触过程的活跃-吸收相变,并揭示物理约束(正定性)对方法有效性的影响。
AI.method: 采用主成分分析(PCA)和变分自编码器(VAE)。针对构型正定性问题:PCA中对数据补充符号反转构型,构造零均值平衡数据集;VAE中采用随控制参数自适应的异方差高斯先验替代固定高斯先验。
AI.result: PCA经去均值增强后,主成分可恢复序参量并重现临界附近的有限尺度标度;VAE用异方差先验后,重构类观测量在临界阈值附近的有限尺度标度显著改善。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习在相变问题中的成功不仅取决于算法复杂度,更取决于表示是否尊重系统的物理结构(内在约束与对称性)。

title: Site-Selective Functional Group Classification of Auger-Electron Spectra and Core-Electron Binding Energies with Convolutional Neural Networks
summary: X-ray spectroscopy techniques probe chemical states in systems with atom-site specificity; however, the site-selective characterization of local bond environments in novel research materials often relies on a combination of reference spectra, multiple complementary spectroscopic techniques and electronic structure calculations. Auger-electron spectroscopy has long accompanied x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy as a second modality to resolve chemical states with overlapping core-electron binding energies. Here I show that the wealth of information encoded in the Auger spectrum offers the opportunity to train convolutional neural networks for site-selective functional group classification in organic molecules directly from the Auger spectrum lineshape. Furthermore, the inclusion of the core-electron binding energy as an additional modality improves the classification, either by augmenting the input fitted intensities with the binding energy or by conditioning the classification on the binding energy via feature-wise linear modulation layers. The latter approach was previously developed for visual reasoning in image classification, and the present results show that this is the more robust approach for including the binding energy. This work demonstrates the potential for new data-driven characterization capabilities in spectroscopic techniques that are information-rich but difficult to interpret.

AI.tldr: 利用卷积神经网络从俄歇电子能谱线形中直接实现有机分子位点选择性官能团分类，并通过结合芯电子结合能进一步提升分类性能。
AI.motivation: X射线谱技术虽能提供原子位点特异的化学态信息，但对新材料的局域键环境进行位点选择性表征往往依赖参考谱、多种互补谱技术及电子结构计算的组合。俄歇电子能谱长期作为XPS的辅助手段来解析具有重叠芯电子结合能的化学态，其中编码的丰富信息尚未被充分挖掘用于数据驱动的表征。
AI.method: 训练卷积神经网络，直接从俄歇谱线形中对有机分子进行位点选择性官能团分类；并将芯电子结合能作为额外模态引入，方式有两种：一是用结合能增强拟合强度输入，二是通过特征级线性调制（FiLM）层将分类条件化于结合能（该方法此前用于图像分类中的视觉推理）。
AI.result: 将结合能作为额外模态可改善分类性能；其中基于FiLM层条件化的方法更为稳健，优于简单地用结合能增强输入强度。
AI.conclusion: 本工作展示了对于信息丰富但难以解释的谱学技术，开发新的数据驱动表征能力的潜力。

title: Hartree-Fock Density-Matrix Renormalization Group for Very Long Chains
summary: We formulate Hartree--Fock as a density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) sweep of a single Slater determinant, assuming a density--density electron--electron interaction. We compress the occupied state and long-range interaction separately, reducing each sweep step to a small local Fock problem. Exchange is retained throughout. Uniform antiferromagnetic hydrogen chains provide an almost ideal setting for this approach, while retaining the Coulomb interaction and its $1/r$ tail. We initialize and converge a chain of 100,000 electrons in 1.8 million spatial basis functions in about two hours on a 64-GB Mac mini, using less than a third of its memory. The work per sweep is nearly proportional to chain length, and the number of sweeps needed for convergence changes little from 1000 to 100,000 atoms. DMRG's compression of states and environments thus makes large HF calculations with long-range Hartree and exchange practical on an ordinary desktop computer.

AI.tldr: 将Hartree-Fock表述为单个Slater行列式的DMRG扫描，通过分别压缩占据态与长程相互作用，把每步化为小型局域Fock问题，在普通桌面电脑上实现超大规模HF计算。
AI.motivation: 大体系的Hartree-Fock计算因长程库仑相互作用和交换项而代价高昂，尤其是含1/r尾的均匀反铁磁氢链，传统方法难以在普通计算机上处理超大体系。
AI.method: 假设密度-密度电子-电子相互作用，把Hartree-Fock写成单个Slater行列式的DMRG扫描；分别压缩占据态与长程相互作用，将每个扫描步归约为小型局域Fock问题，并全程保留交换作用。
AI.result: 在保留库仑相互作用及其1/r尾的均匀反铁磁氢链上，用64 GB Mac mini约两小时、不到三分之一内存，初始化并收敛了含10万个电子、180万个空间基函数的链；每步计算量近似正比于链长，收敛所需扫描数从1000到10万个原子变化很小。
AI.conclusion: DMRG对态与环境的压缩使含长程Hartree与交换的大规模HF计算在普通桌面电脑上变得可行。

title: Probing proximity-induced superconductivity in bilayer graphene using gate-defined quantum dots
summary: Van der Waals heterostructures offer a direct way of combining two-dimensional (2D) materials with different electronic properties, such as 2D semiconductors, metals, and superconductors, in a single device. Bilayer graphene (BLG) is particularly attractive in this context, as its electrically tunable band gap enables local control of tunnel barriers and quantum dots. Here, we realize an all-2D hybrid platform based on BLG proximitized by superconducting NbSe$_2$. Using local electrostatic gates, we define tunnel barriers and quantum dots at different distances from the lateral superconductor-semiconductor interface. The quantum dots serve as local spectroscopic probes of the proximitized BLG channel segment, forming tunable superconductor-quantum dot-normal conductor junction devices. Coulomb blockade and finite-bias spectroscopy reveal a proximity-induced superconducting gap of up to $80\,\mathrm{μeV}$ and allow to track its evolution with increasing distance from the NbSe$_2$ contact. We find that the local density of states remains suppressed over distances exceeding 1 $μ$m, consistent with superconducting proximity through a highly ballistic BLG channel. Our results show that BLG-superconductor hybrids offer a controllable platform where quantum dots and quantum point contacts can be well combined with superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 作者构建了基于双层石墨烯(BLG)与超导NbSe₂ proximitized的全二维混合平台，通过局域栅极定义隧穿势垒和量子点，测得最大80 μeV的邻近诱导超导能隙，并发现局域态密度在超过1 μm距离上仍被抑制，表明高度弹道的BLG通道支持超导邻近效应。
AI.motivation: 范德瓦尔斯异质结构可将不同电子性质的二维材料集成于单一器件，其中BLG因电可调带隙可局域控制隧穿势垒和量子点，非常具有吸引力。作者希望结合超导体与BLG，构建可调的超导-量子点-正常导体结平台，以研究超导邻近效应及其空间演化。
AI.method: 以BLG与超导NbSe₂构成全二维混合平台，利用局域静电栅极在与超导-半导体横向界面不同距离处定义隧穿势垒和量子点，将量子点作为局域谱学探针，通过库仑阻塞和有限偏压谱学测量邻近诱导超导能隙及其随距离的演化。
AI.result: 测得最大约80 μeV的邻近诱导超导能隙，并追踪其随距NbSe₂接触距离增加的演化；发现局域态密度在超过1 μm距离上仍保持被抑制，与高度弹道的BLG通道中的超导邻近效应一致。
AI.conclusion: BLG-超导体混合体系提供了一个可控平台，可将量子点和量子点接触与超导性良好结合，为研究超导邻近效应及相关量子器件提供了新途径。

title: Mode-selective phonon effects on magnetism and superconductivity in trilayer nickelates
summary: The discovery of high-$T_c$ superconductivity in multilayer nickelates has stimulated intense interest, yet the microscopic origins of their correlated states remain debated. Recently the observed isotope effect of the magnetic state in trilayer nickelates highlights the important role of lattice vibrations in shaping these systems. Here, we investigate the impact of electron-phonon coupling (EPC) on magnetism and superconductivity in trilayer nickelates using ab initio and functional renormalization group calculations. We identify out-of-plane oxygen breathing modes with pronounced EPC and construct symmetry-resolved, layer-dependent couplings. Their relative phases across the three layers generate distinct retarded interactions, producing mode-selective enhancement or suppression of spin-density-wave order and $s_\pm$-wave superconductivity. This selectivity arises from screening-mediated spin-phonon interplay across a hierarchy of energy scales: EPC modifies charge screening at higher energies, reshapes magnetic fluctuations at lower energies, and ultimately influences pairing. Selected modes yield negative isotope coefficients for the magnetic state, qualitatively consistent with experiments. Our results establish how interlayer phonons modify electronically driven order and provide a microscopic framework for understanding isotope effects in trilayer nickelates.

AI.tldr: 本文通过从头算与泛函重整化群方法研究三层镍酸盐中电子-声子耦合对磁性与超导的影响，揭示层间声子如何选择性调控自旋密度波与s±波超导。
AI.motivation: 多层镍酸盐高温超导的关联态微观起源仍有争议，且实验中三层镍酸盐磁态的同位素效应表明晶格振动起重要作用，需要理论框架解释。
AI.method: 采用从头算和泛函重整化群计算，识别具有显著电子-声子耦合的面外氧呼吸模式，构建按对称性分辨、依赖层数的耦合，并分析三层间相对相位产生的推迟相互作用。
AI.result: 不同模式的相对相位产生不同的推迟相互作用，导致对自旋密度波序和s±波超导的模式选择性增强或抑制；该选择性源于筛选介导的自旋-声子相互作用在不同能标层级的作用。选定模式给出磁态的负同位素系数，与实验定性一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了层间声子如何改变电子驱动的有序态，并为理解三层镍酸盐中的同位素效应提供了微观框架。

title: Implicit Lagrangian Hydrodynamics with High-Order Finite Elements
summary: We present an implicit time integration capability for high-order curvilinear finite element Lagrangian hydrodynamics. Starting from an existing explicit formulation, the implicit treatment builds directly on the original discretization and operator structure and does not alter the underlying spatial formulation or physics model. We demonstrate our implementation using the Laghos miniapp, which is built on the MFEM finite element library. To support gradient-based nonlinear solution methods, we compute Jacobian actions automatically using MFEM's $\partial$FEM interface together with Enzyme-based automatic differentiation, and apply the resulting Jacobian in a matrix-free or fully-assembled manner within a Newton-Krylov solver. To ensure robust and differentiable nonlinear solves in the presence of shocks, we introduce a smooth artificial viscosity treatment based on smooth approximations of non-differentiable pointwise operations. The differentiable artificial viscosity presently lacks a limiter to ensure high-order scaling away from shocks, but is sufficient for illustrating the benefits of implicit Lagrangian hydrodynamics. The behavior and performance of the implicit method are demonstrated on several standard benchmark problems. We verify high-order convergence on the smooth Taylor-Green vortex in the absence of artificial viscosity, show correct strong-shock behavior on the Sedov blast problem, and obtain significant improvements in accuracy-per-time-to-solution on the Triple Point problem where explicit stability constraints become increasingly severe for high-order discretizations.

AI.tldr: 本文为高阶曲线有限元拉格朗日流体力学引入隐式时间积分能力，基于MFEM与Enzyme自动微分实现Newton-Krylov求解，并在多个基准问题上验证性能。
AI.motivation: 高阶离散下显式稳定性约束日益严苛，需要隐式时间积分来提升精度与求解时间的性价比。
AI.method: 依托现有显式格式与算子结构，不改动空间离散；用MFEM ∂FEM接口结合Enzyme自动微分计算Jacobian作用，在Newton-Krylov中以矩阵自由或完全组装方式求解；引入基于光滑近似的可微人工粘性处理激波。
AI.result: 无粘时在Taylor-Green涡上验证高阶收敛；Sedov爆炸显示正确强激波行为；Triple Point问题上精度-求解时间比显著改善。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效，但当前可微人工粘性缺少限制器，无法在远离激波处保证高阶精度缩放，是可改进之处。

title: Orbital-resolved superexchange and topological magnon bands in MXene Fe$_2$C
summary: Magnetic MXenes are promising candidates for future spintronics due to their intriguing properties. Nevertheless, the topological properties of magnon bands and superexchange mechanism remain relatively underexplored. In this work, we have calculated the spin wave dispersions for MXene Fe$_2$C using the linear spin wave method, with the exchange coupling parameters obtained from first-principles calculations. Owing to the staggered stacking of two Fe sub-lattices, the interlayer exchange coupling lifts the degeneracy of the ferromagnetic magnon modes. A Dirac point is identified in the magnon bands at the $K$ point. The topological properties of magnon bands, including Berry curvature, valley Chern number and edge states, are further computed by means of a two-band model. We also derive an effective Hamiltonian to explain the magnonic topology, which is protected by the $C_{3v}$ rotational symmetry. To understand the microscopic origin of the exchange couplings that govern the magnon bands, we then construct a refined model integrating perturbation theory and the tight-binding approach. The ferromagnetic superexchange coupling is mediated by the virtual hopping between the d orbitals of two distinct Fe sites via a pair of orthogonal p orbitals at the bridging C site. In detail, the intralayer exchange coupling is governed by the in-plane $p_x$ and $p_y$ orbitals, while the out-of-plane $p_z$ orbital is responsible for the interlayer exchange coupling. Our results establish a direct link between the orbital-resolved anisotropic superexchange and topological properties of the magnon bands in magnetic MXene Fe$_2$C, providing theoretical guidance for future spintronics applications.

AI.tldr: 本文计算了磁性MXene Fe2C的自旋波色散，发现磁振子带在K点存在狄拉克点，并研究了其拓扑性质及轨道分辨的超交换机制。
AI.motivation: 磁性MXene在自旋电子学中前景广阔，但其磁振子带的拓扑性质和超交换机制尚缺乏深入研究。
AI.method: 采用线性自旋波方法计算Fe2C的自旋波色散，交换耦合参数由第一性原理获得；用两带模型计算贝里曲率、谷陈数和边缘态；结合微扰论与紧束缚方法构建精细模型解析轨道分辨的超交换耦合。
AI.result: 两层Fe亚晶格的交错堆叠使层间交换耦合解除铁磁磁振子模的简并；在K点发现磁振子带狄拉克点；由C3v旋转对称性保护；层内交换耦合由面内px、py轨道主导，层间交换耦合由面外pz轨道主导。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了轨道分辨的各向异性超交换与磁振子带拓扑性质之间的直接联系，为未来自旋电子学应用提供理论指导。

title: Diffusivity in Dissipative Quantum Transport from an Exactly Solvable Krylov Chain
summary: The computation of transport coefficients in interacting quantum many-body systems is rarely analytically accessible. Here, we develop a new Krylov-space mechanism that makes the leading density dependent correction to Green-Kubo diffusivity \emph{exactly} calculable in the strong-dissipation regime of a one-dimensional noisy spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ XXZ chain. This is done by showing that the density-polarization-dressed bond coherence generates a Krylov subspace where repeated action of the dissipator closes exactly on an explicitly identifiable operator family. Within this subspace, the dissipative dynamics is then mapped onto a self-similar semi-infinite chain with a boundary defect. Surprisingly, \emph{all} Lanczos coefficients of the Krylov chain and its boundary Green's function can be determined exactly. The latter then determines the exact leading density-dependent correction to the diffusivity. Finally, we calculate analytically the full boundary-to-bulk Green's function and find that it decays exponentially along the emergent Krylov chain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的Krylov空间机制，使一维噪声自旋-1/2 XXZ链在强耗散区中Green-Kubo扩散率的主导密度依赖修正可被精确计算。
AI.motivation: 相互作用量子多体系统的输运系数计算通常难以解析处理，本文旨在解决强耗散极限下扩散率的密度依赖修正问题。
AI.method: 通过引入密度-极化修饰的键相干，构造出使耗散子反复作用精确闭合于可识别算符族的Krylov子空间，并将其动力学映射为带边界缺陷的自相似半无限链，精确求解Lanczos系数与边界Green函数。
AI.result: 所有Lanczos系数与边界Green函数均可精确确定，从而得到扩散率的主导密度依赖修正；进一步解析计算完整的边界到体Green函数，发现其沿涌现Krylov链指数衰减。
AI.conclusion: 该Krylov空间机制为强耗散量子多体系统中输运系数的解析计算提供了新的精确途径。

title: Discovering Kinetically Significant Reaction Mechanisms Beyond Chemical Intuition in Condensed-Phase Radiolysis
summary: Many important chemical systems, from radiation-driven processes to condensed-phase photochemistry, involve reaction mechanisms that are so complex it is a challenge to characterize them experimentally or predict them from chemical intuition. Existing computational approaches to mechanism discovery typically assess pathway importance through thermodynamic favorability alone, which does not provide time-dependent kinetics or inform how to model spatial inhomogeneities. Here we describe an integrated workflow that discovers complex reaction mechanisms without prescribing them and connects molecular-scale reactivity to spatiotemporal observables. The workflow combines high-throughput DFT, automated reaction network construction with chemical plausibility filtering, stochastic pathway sampling to identify reactions which are likely to occur, and spatially resolved reaction-diffusion kinetics simulations with explicit tracking of species in space and time. To demonstrate the workflow on a system of high complexity, we apply it to radiolytic chemistry in an extreme ultraviolet (EUV) organic polymer thin film photoresist, where a single 92 eV photon initiates cascades of radical ions, fragments, and low-energy electrons across a nanoscale radiolytic spur. Starting from over 3,300 species and millions of candidate reactions, the workflow identifies the most likely reaction pathways and produces spatiotemporal maps that resolve product formation on femtosecond-to-nanosecond timescales across a 15.5-nm domain. The simulations predict products detected experimentally and reveal that the identity of the initially photoionized species profoundly shapes the downstream product distribution through multi-step pathways governing the balance between deprotection and crosslinking reactions. The methodology is broadly applicable to complex condensed-phase reactive systems.

AI.tldr: 提出集成工作流，无需预设即可发现复杂反应机理，并将分子尺度反应性与时空可观测量连接起来；应用于EUV光刻胶辐射化学，从3300+物种和数百万候选反应中识别最可能路径，生成飞秒到纳秒、15.5 nm范围的时空产物图。
AI.motivation: 许多重要化学体系（如辐射驱动过程、凝聚相光化学）的反应机理极其复杂，实验表征困难、化学直觉也难以预测。现有计算机理发现方法多以热力学有利性评估路径重要性，无法给出时间依赖动力学，也无法建模空间不均匀性。
AI.method: 集成工作流：高通量DFT + 自动反应网络构建与化学合理性过滤 + 随机路径采样识别可能发生的反应 + 空间分辨反应-扩散动力学模拟（显式追踪物种在空间与时间上的演化）。应用于EUV有机聚合物薄膜光刻胶中92 eV光子引发的辐射分解化学。
AI.result: 从3300+物种与数百万候选反应出发，识别最可能反应路径，生成飞秒至纳秒、15.5 nm区域的时空产物分布图；模拟预测出实验检测到的产物；发现初始光离子化物种的身份通过多步路径显著影响下游产物分布，控制去保护与交联反应的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流能发现复杂反应机理并将分子尺度反应性与时空可观测量关联，适用于广泛复杂凝聚相反应体系。

title: La substitution studies on the heavy-fermion superconductor CeRh$_2$As$_2$
summary: CeRh$_2$As$_2$ has been receiving considerable attention due to its unusual two-phase superconductivity. The superconducting (SC) phase appears at $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ = 0.35 K in an ordered state (phase I) of the Ce-4$f$ moments, which develops below $T_{\mathrm{0}}$ = 0.55 K. The microscopic nature of phase I has not been fully established yet. We report a single-crystal study of the effect of La substitution on these low-temperature phases in Ce$_{1-\textit{x}}$La$_\textit{x}$Rh$_2$As$_2$ up to $x$ = 0.1. The lattice parameters increase monotonically with $x$, corresponding to an effective negative pressure of approximately -0.3 GPa for $x$ = 0.1. While the Ce$^{3+}$ local valence state and the non-Fermi-liquid behavior are preserved, the resistivity coherence maximum $T^{*}_{\mathrm{max}}$ $\approx$ 45 K in the pristine sample shifts to lower temperatures with increasing $x$, indicating a suppression of the Kondo energy scale upon lattice expansion. On the other hand, both $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ and $T_{\mathrm{0}}$ are rapidly suppressed to below 0.1 K for $x$ $>$ 0.05. Notably, such a rapid decrease of $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ under moderate negative pressure is unexpected, but is rather consistent with substitution-induced disorder effect which leads to strong pair breaking in unconventional superconductors. The observed fragility of phase I under both pressure and disorder may imply its itinerant origin.

AI.tldr: 本文通过La替代(等效负压约-0.3 GPa)研究CeRh2As2低温相，发现Tc和T0对晶格膨胀极敏感，快速被抑制，暗示相I可能源于巡游电子。
AI.motivation: CeRh2As2具有异常的两相超导性，超导相出现在Ce-4f有序态(相I)中，但相I的微观本质尚未明确，需通过调控手段探究其起源。
AI.method: 生长Ce1-xLaxRh2As2(x≤0.1)单晶，利用La替代引入等效负压，测量晶格参数、Ce价态、电阻率及Tc、T0随x的变化。
AI.result: 晶格参数随x单调增大；Ce3+局域价态与非费米液体行为保持不变；Kondo能量尺度随晶格膨胀被抑制(Tmax下降)；Tc和T0在x>0.05时快速降至0.1 K以下。
AI.conclusion: Tc在中等负压下急剧下降不符常规，更符合无序诱导的强配对破坏；相I在压力和替位无序下的脆弱性暗示其具有巡游电子起源。

title: Entropy-driven transitions between extended integer and fractional quantum Hall regimes
summary: Electronic states with coexisting Wigner-crystal order can sometimes exhibit a quantum Hall effect over a finite range of electron densities---i.e., exhibit ``extended'' quantum Hall (QH) plateaus in the absence of disorder. Such an extended quantum Hall state can then compete with other QH states over the same density range, allowing a first-order thermal transition between them. Here, we analyze several settings in which the entropy associated with Goldstone modes (e.g., magnons or phonons) or soft gapped modes (e.g., magnetoroton) drives a finite-temperature transition between competing QH regimes. Applying this framework to moiré rhombohedral graphene, we argue that a soft magnetoroton in a fractional quantum anomalous Hall state provides a plausible bulk mechanism for the observed thermal evolution from an extended integer QH to a fractional QH regime.

AI.tldr: 本文分析共存Wigner晶体序的电子态在无序缺失下可呈现"扩展"量子霍尔平台，并研究由Goldstone模式（磁振子、声子）或软隙模式（磁振子）熵驱动的竞争QH态间有限温度相变，应用于莫尔菱面体石墨烯解释从扩展整数QH到分数QH的热演化。
AI.motivation: 扩展量子霍尔态可与其他QH态在相同密度范围竞争，可能发生一阶热相变，但驱动这种转变的有限温度机制（尤其是熵来源）尚需系统分析。
AI.method: 分析多种情形，研究Goldstone模式（磁振子、声子）或软隙模式（磁振子/磁旋子）的熵如何驱动竞争QH区间的有限温度转变；并将该框架应用于莫尔菱面体石墨烯。
AI.result: 在分数量子反常霍尔态中，软磁旋子（magnetoroton）提供了一种可信的体相机制，可解释实验观测到的从扩展整数QH到分数QH区间的热演化。
AI.conclusion: Goldstone/软隙模式的熵可驱动竞争量子霍尔态间的一阶热相变，软磁旋子机制解释了莫尔菱面体石墨烯中整数到分数QH的热演化。

title: Current - voltage characteristics in magnetic field for layered superconductor with intrinsic pinning of Josephson vortices
summary: The results of measurements of the transverse voltage in the Hall configuration, Uy, under conditions of motion of the charge and vortex subsystems in orhtogonal magnetic and electric fields on epitaxial films of the layered high-temperature superconductor Nd2-xCexCuO4 are presented. the motion of Josephson vortices across CuO2 layers (along the c-axis) is analyzed considering the effects of intrinsic pinning. An exponential dependence of critical depinning current jc(B) for Josephson vortices is established in contrast to the power law dependences for Abrikosov vortices. With increasing external magnetic field after the depinning by a magnetic field at B=Bc, the onset of the vortex creep regime, which evolves into the flux-flow regime at crossover field B=Bf, is observed.

AI.tldr: 在高Tc超导体Nd2-xCexCuO4薄膜中测量霍尔构型横向电压，研究约瑟夫森涡旋沿c轴运动及内禀钉扎效应，发现其脱钉电流呈指数依赖，并观测到从涡旋蠕变到磁通流动的转变。
AI.motivation: 探究层状高温超导体中电荷与涡旋子系统在正交电磁场下的输运行为，特别是约瑟夫森涡旋穿层运动受内禀钉扎影响时与Abrikosov涡旋的差异。
AI.method: 在Nd2-xCexCuO4外延薄膜上测量霍尔构型横向电压Uy，施加正交磁场与电场驱动涡旋运动，分析内禀钉扎下约瑟夫森涡旋的临界脱钉电流及场依赖关系。
AI.result: 约瑟夫森涡旋的临界脱钉电流jc(B)呈指数依赖，不同于Abrikosov涡旋的幂律依赖；随外磁场增大至Bc发生场致脱钉，随后进入涡旋蠕变区，并在交叉场Bf处演化为磁通流动区。
AI.conclusion: 约瑟夫森涡旋的脱钉与运动行为受内禀钉扎支配，其指数型jc(B)规律及蠕变-流动转变揭示了层状超导体中涡旋动力学的独特特征。

title: An energy stable and accuracy-preserving finite volume scheme based on the SAV method with application to wall-distance computation
summary: A novel semi-implicit second-order finite volume scheme integrating the scalar auxiliary variable (SAV) approach is proposed for solving the pseudo-time Eikonal equation in wall-distance computation. Unconditional energy stability under zero boundary conditions is rigorously proved, eliminating the dependence of the time step on the grid scale and enabling large-time-step computation. The scheme is a priori accuracy-preserving, and its discretization matrix forms an M-matrix, thereby guaranteeing strict non-negativity of the numerical solution inherently. The framework extends readily to any non-conservative scalar equation and, being independent of the specific finite-volume reconstruction, is compatible with schemes of arbitrary order of accuracy. A vanishing artificial viscosity is introduced to smooth the solution without compromising formal accuracy, and upwinding is incorporated through directional weighting in the weighted least-squares (WLS) reconstruction. Numerical experiments confirm that the scheme achieves the designed accuracy and permits stable computations with uniformly large time steps. For complex configurations such as a three-element airfoil and the three-dimensional ONERA M6 wing, accurate results are obtained on high-aspect-ratio grids, with relative errors in the computed wall distance below 3\% relative to the search-based reference, except near geometric singularities.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合标量辅助变量(SAV)的半隐式二阶有限体积格式，用于伪时间Eikonal方程求解壁面距离，具备无条件能量稳定、保精度、M矩阵非负等特性，并验证于复杂外形。
AI.motivation: 壁面距离计算中的伪时间Eikonal方程求解需要稳定且高效的方法，传统方法时间步受网格尺度限制，且难以保证解的严格非负性。作者希望消除时间步对网格尺度的依赖，实现大时间步稳定计算，并保持精度与非负性。
AI.method: 将标量辅助变量(SAV)方法与半隐式二阶有限体积格式结合求解伪时间Eikonal方程。零边界条件下严格证明无条件能量稳定；离散矩阵为M矩阵从而保证非负性。引入消失的人工粘性以平滑解而不损失形式精度，并通过方向加权在加权最小二乘(WLS)重构中实现迎风。框架可推广至任意非保守标量方程，且独立于具体有限体积重构，兼容任意精度阶。
AI.result: 数值实验表明格式达到设计精度，并允许均匀大时间步稳定计算。在三元素翼型和三维ONERA M6机翼等高长宽比网格上，计算壁面距离相对搜索法参考解的误差低于3%，仅在几何奇点附近除外。
AI.conclusion: 该SAV半隐式有限体积格式实现了伪时间Eikonal方程的无条件稳定、保精度、非负求解，适合复杂外形高长宽比网格的壁面距离计算，且具有良好通用性与可扩展性。

title: Exotic centrosymmetric phase of acentric urea under high pressure
summary: Urea is a simple prototype supramolecular crystal that exhibits rich polymorphism at low pressure due to broken and restored N-H-O hydrogen bonds. The high pressure polymorph (phase V') of acentric urea crystallizes in a centrosymmetric structure, which presents an appealing target because of its potential exotic structure, analogous to the symmetric ice phase X. The pressure-induced polymorphism of urea was studied using powder X-ray diffraction, infrared and Raman spectroscopy, second harmonic generation (SHG) measurements up to 20 GPa and ab initio crystal structure prediction (CSP) based on the constrained evolutionary approach. A strong decrease of the SHG signal at the transition pressure 10 GPa reveals that the high-pressure polymorph is indeed centrosymmetric, further confirmed by the selection rules observed in the lattice vibration modes, in contrast to chemical intuition for acentric urea. The structural evolution sequence obtained from X-ray diffraction, SHG and CSP calculations is as follows: phase I (P421m; Z=2) from 0 to 0.5 GPa, Phase III (P212121; Z=4) from 0.5 to 5.2 GPa, and phase V' (P21/m; Z=6) beyond 10.0 GPa which is energetically competitive with the theoretically predicted phase V (Pnma; Z=4). A phase X with distinct spectral and diffraction features forms between 5.2 and 10.0 GPa, which could be explained by a quantum disorder intermediate state between phase III and V', that is ascribed to the difficulty to disrupt the H-bonding network under extremely compressed environment. The softening of N-H vibrations and the change in intensity of the vibrations associated with the hydrogen bonding provide evidence for proton tunneling and charge-transfer interaction in phase X.

AI.tldr: 高压下尿素的多晶型转变研究，揭示其在10 GPa以上形成中心对称相V'及中间相X。
AI.motivation: 尿素是简单超分子晶体，低压下因N-H-O氢键断裂与重建呈现丰富多晶型。高压多晶型V'（来自非中心对称尿素）本应形成非中心对称结构，但可能类似对称冰相X，具有奇特结构，值得探究其压力诱导多晶型行为。
AI.method: 采用粉末X射线衍射、红外与拉曼光谱、二次谐波产生（SHG）测量（最高20 GPa），以及基于约束进化方法的从头算晶体结构预测（CSP）。
AI.result: 10 GPa转变压力处SHG信号强烈下降，表明高压多晶型为中心对称，晶格振动模式选择定则进一步证实。结构演化序列为：相I（P421m; Z=2, 0-0.5 GPa）、相III（P212121; Z=4, 0.5-5.2 GPa）、相V'（P21/m; Z=6, >10 GPa），V'与理论预测相V（Pnma; Z=4）能量竞争。5.2-10.0 GPa间形成具有独特光谱和衍射特征的相X。
AI.conclusion: 相X可能是相III与V'之间的量子无序中间态，源于极端压缩环境下难以破坏氢键网络。N-H振动软化和氢键相关振动强度变化为相X中质子隧穿和电荷转移相互作用提供了证据。

title: Odd diffusion and power-law correlations in chiral mass-transport processes
summary: We study mass-conserving Markov jump processes on a square lattice, where masses hop with a preferred rotational sense, thus breaking both time-reversal and mirror symmetries. We consider closed systems with both periodic and open (reflecting) boundaries, the latter supporting a steady-state edge current. We show that odd diffusion, arising from the chiral transport, generically provides a mechanism for the emergence of scale-invariant two-point density correlations in nonequilibrium steady states even in the presence of lattice rotation symmetry -- a mechanism that is qualitatively distinct from the well-known mechanism of anisotropic hopping. We exactly calculate the steady-state equal-time density-density correlations, which exhibit an algebraic decay, $C(\mathbf{r}) \sim |\mathbf{r}|^{-4}$ for $|\mathbf{r}| \gg 1$. This algebraic behavior results from the interplay between the off-diagonal components of the diffusion and mobility tensors, demonstrating that chiral transport alone can generate power-law correlations in isotropic driven systems. Remarkably, the structure factor in the zero-wavenumber limit and the amplitude of the power laws depend nontrivially on chirality. While increasing chirality initially suppresses large-scale density fluctuations, the fluctuations beyond a threshold odd-diffusion strength vary nonmonotonically with chirality and develop a cusp singularity.

AI.tldr: 研究方格子上带偏好旋转方向的守恒质量马尔可夫跳跃过程，发现奇扩散（odd diffusion）可使各向同性手性输运系统中出现尺度不变的幂律密度关联，C(r)~|r|^{-4}。
AI.motivation: 探索手性输运（同时破坏时间反演与镜像对称）是否能在不依赖各向异性跳跃的情况下，于各向同性驱动系统中产生尺度不变的两点密度关联，并澄清其机制。
AI.method: 在方格子上定义质量守恒的马尔可夫跳跃过程，质量按偏好旋转方向跳跃；考虑周期边界与开放（反射）边界（后者支持稳态边缘流），精确计算稳态等时密度-密度关联函数与结构因子。
AI.result: 精确求得稳态密度关联呈代数衰减 C(r)~|r|^{-4}（|r|≫1），源于扩散张量与迁移率张量的非对角分量耦合；零波数极限结构因子与幂律幅度非平凡依赖手性，手性增强最初抑制大尺度涨落，超过奇扩散强度阈值后涨落随手性非单调变化并出现尖点奇异。
AI.conclusion: 手性输运本身即可在各向同性驱动系统中产生幂律关联，其机制与各向异性跳跃机制本质不同，奇扩散是尺度不变关联出现的通用机制。

title: QALPA: Property-guided diffusion modeling for efficient exploration of chemical spaces of flexible molecules
summary: Exploring the chemical space of flexible molecules remains challenging because the vast number of possible compounds and conformations, together with the increasing cost and limited generalization of 3D generative models for larger and more complex molecules, restrict access to unexplored chemistry. Here, we introduce QALPA ("Quantum-Aware Learning for Property-space Augmentation"), a property-guided generative framework that combines an E(3)-equivariant diffusion model with active learning and efficient quantum-mechanical (QM) methods to iteratively explore targeted QM property manifolds. By coupling generation with physics-based evaluation, QALPA improves molecular sampling and model reliability in sparsely populated regions of chemical space. Our results show that training on complementary QM datasets spanning both small (QM7-X) and large (Aquamarine) drug-like compounds enables accurate molecular generation across a broad size range, improving transferability beyond the training distribution for complex property manifolds involving both extensive and intensive properties. As a proof of concept, QALPA coupled with the machine learning-augmented tight-binding method EquiDTB efficiently augments alloQM, a QM dataset introduced in this work, comprising 6,253 conformers of allosteric drug molecules, by populating sparse regions of the property landscape defined by the many-body dispersion energy and HOMO-LUMO energy gap. These results demonstrate that the integration of generative AI with efficient ML/QM methods offers a practical pathway toward augmenting sparse QM datasets and sustainably expanding the exploration of chemical space for molecular discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出QALPA框架，结合E(3)-等变扩散模型、主动学习与高效量子力学方法，实现性质引导的分子生成，可有效扩充稀疏的QM数据集并拓展化学空间探索。
AI.motivation: 柔性分子的化学空间探索困难：可能的化合物与构象数量庞大，且3D生成模型对更大更复杂分子成本高、泛化差，导致难以触及未探索的化学区域。
AI.method: QALPA（Quantum-Aware Learning for Property-space Augmentation）是一个性质引导的生成框架，将E(3)-等变扩散模型与主动学习、高效QM方法结合，通过生成与物理评估的耦合迭代探索目标QM性质流形，提升稀疏区域的采样与模型可靠性。
AI.result: 在小分子(QM7-X)与大分子(Aquamarine)互补QM数据集上训练，实现跨尺寸范围的准确生成，并提升对分布外复杂性质流形（含广延与内蕴性质）的可迁移性。概念验证中，QALPA结合ML增强紧束缚方法EquiDTB，成功扩充了新提出的alloQM数据集（含6,253个变构药物分子构象），填补了由多体色散能与HOMO-LUMO能隙定义的稀疏性质区域。
AI.conclusion: 将生成式AI与高效ML/QM方法结合，为扩充稀疏QM数据集、可持续拓展分子发现中的化学空间探索提供了实用路径。

title: Accurate noise spectroscopy using quantum sensing ensembles
summary: Noise spectroscopy with quantum sensors is a powerful tool for characterising the properties of the sensor environment and detecting critical magnetic phenomena. While replacing single sensors with large ensembles promises substantial gains in measurement sensitivity and field of view, the output becomes difficult to interpret when there is a variable coupling to targets across the sensing ensemble. In this work we present an analysis procedure for accessing the true source noise spectrum using ensemble coherence from dynamical decoupling measurements. We show that sequence timing plays a dual role in ensemble noise spectroscopy, setting both the frequency selectivity and the weighted collection of signal across the ensemble, and demonstrate how incorporation of the coupling distribution allows accurate parameter extraction of the noise. We apply this procedure to a model system, shallow nitrogen-vacancy centres in diamond, and show that consistent information about the spectral character of MHz-range surface noise can be obtained from two sensing ensembles featuring distinct depth distributions. Our results pave the way for using large quantum sensor ensembles for quantitative, broadband noise spectroscopy, with straightforward extension to other solid-state and molecular sensing platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于系综相干性（动力学解耦测量）的分析方法，用于从耦合分布不均匀的量子传感器系综中提取真实的噪声源谱，并以金刚石浅层NV色心验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 将单个量子传感器替换为大型系综可显著提升测量灵敏度和视场，但系综中各传感器与目标的耦合强度可变，导致输出信号难以解释，无法直接还原真实噪声谱。
AI.method: 提出一套从动力学解耦测量的系综相干性中恢复真实源噪声谱的分析流程。揭示序列时序在系综噪声谱学中的双重作用：既决定频率选择性，又决定跨系综信号的加权收集方式；并将耦合分布纳入分析以实现噪声参数的精确提取。以金刚石浅层氮-空位（NV）色心为模型系统进行验证。
AI.result: 在具有不同深度分布的两个传感系综上，均能获得关于MHz范围表面噪声谱特性的一致信息，证明该流程可准确提取噪声参数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为使用大型量子传感器系综进行定量、宽带噪声谱学铺平了道路，并可简单推广至其他固态和分子传感平台。

title: NaFeP: first pairing prediction for an unmade 111 iron phosphide, and the pnictogen-height rule inside one compound
comment: 22 pages, 11 figures. Companion to arXiv:2609.10614. The sealed gap-symmetry verdict (gap_nafep_0914.json) and the 58-composition screening list are provided as ancillary files
summary: Companion to arXiv:2609.10614, which built a physics judge that classifies the gap symmetry of a superconductor candidate from its structure and showed that generation in the wire families re-finds the known canon. Here the judge is applied end to end to the single compound that survived its own screen. From 58 iron-pnictide compositions in the electronic window of BaFe$_2$As$_2$ absent from the Materials Project, a zero-cost literature-and-stability screen leaves one with no bulk synthesis and no band-structure, magnetic or pairing calculation: NaFeP (111-type, P4/nmm, Fe$^{2+}$ d$^6$, arsenic-free). The judge, refined with an explicit Stoner gate and a frame-independent symmetry reader, returns a paramagnetic DFT ground state and an s$\pm$ gap: a clean sign reversal between the hole cylinders at Gamma and the electron sheets at the zone corner, at nesting vector (1/2,1/2,1/2), in every basis and cell tried. Whether the gap is nodeless is where the instrument is tested. The phosphorus height (1.16 Å) lies below the empirical threshold of about 1.33 Åseparating nodal from nodeless pnictides, so the structural rule calls NaFeP nodal. The sealed verdict on a metal-only basis said nodeless; a d+p basis that passes the same gates puts the inner hole cylinder at the node threshold (min|g|/max|g| = 0.07-0.10), and a scan of the phosphorus height reproduces, inside one compound, the ingredients of the height rule: a third hole pocket, a switch of the nesting vector to (1/2,1/2,0), a monotonic approach to the Stoner instability, and near-degeneracy of s$\pm$ and d channels beyond 1.33 Å. The prediction we stand behind is the d+p reading: an s$\pm$ superconductor with a near-nodal inner hole sheet, on the LiFeP side of the rule, with the disagreement between bases reported, not resolved by choice. No Tc is asserted; the discriminating measurement, nodal or nodeless, is stated in advance.

AI.tldr: 将物理判据端到端应用于筛选中存活的NaFeP，预测其为s±超导体，内空穴面近节点，介于节点与否的临界。
AI.motivation: 前作建立了从结构判断超导体配对对称性的物理判据。本文针对筛选后唯一存活的化合物NaFeP进行端到端验证。
AI.method: 对58种铁磷族化合物筛选，得到无块体合成与计算的NaFeP；用带Stoner门和框架无关对称读取器的判据，测试多种基组与元胞，并扫描磷高度。
AI.result: 得到顺磁DFT基态与s±配对，Γ空穴柱与角点电子面在(1/2,1/2,1/2)处符号反转。金属基组判为无节点，d+p基组给内空穴面近节点(min|g|/max|g|=0.07–0.10)；磷高度1.16 Å低于经验阈值1.33 Å，结构规则判为节点。
AI.conclusion: 作者认同d+p读数：NaFeP为s±超导体、内空穴面近节点，位于规则LiFeP侧，报告而不消解基组分歧；不声明Tc，预先给出节点与否的判别测量。

title: Adding slow magnetoacoustic mode to the HLL-type multi-state approximate Riemann solution
summary: Multi-state HLL-type approximate Riemann solutions of ideal magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) typically assume that the medium within the Riemann fan is incompressible, and thus the slow magnetoacoustic mode cannot be included in their space-time wave configurations for the approximated states. We propose a new strategy to design multi-state HLL-type approximate solutions, allowing for the medium within the Riemann fan to be compressible. In particular, for the complete seven-wave configuration of the MHD Riemann problem, we first estimate the slow magnetoacoustic speeds and a longitudinal flow speed between the slow modes, and then follow the conservation laws and Rankine-Hugoniot jump relations across the fast, Alfvén, and slow waves, to calculate all the intermediate states within the Riemann fan. Moreover, we discuss the solutions when certain wave modes degenerate, ensuring well-posedness and smooth transitions between complete and degenerate wave configurations. Numerical simulations using a Finite Volume (FV) solver show that the proposed approximate Riemann solution is less diffusive than the classic HLLD scheme, particularly for slow mode waves. For example, in a 1D test case with a strong longitudinal magnetic field, the new scheme needs one order of magnitude fewer grid cells compared to the classic HLLD scheme to resolve all wave modes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种新的多态HLL型近似黎曼解法，允许黎曼扇内介质可压缩，从而将慢磁声波纳入波结构，模拟显示其比经典HLLD更少耗散。
AI.motivation: 经典多态HLL型近似黎曼解法（如HLLD）通常假设黎曼扇内介质不可压缩，导致无法将慢磁声波模式纳入近似态的时空波结构，影响对慢波的解析精度。
AI.method: 允许黎曼扇内介质可压缩：先估计慢磁声波速度及慢波之间的纵向流速，再依据守恒律和跨越快波、Alfvén波与慢波的Rankine-Hugoniot跳跃关系计算黎曼扇内全部中间态；并讨论波模式退化情形以保证良态性与完整/退化波结构间的平滑过渡。
AI.result: 基于有限体积求解器的数值模拟表明，所提近似黎曼解比经典HLLD耗散更小，尤其对慢波；例如在强纵向磁场的一维测试中，新格式解析全部波模式所需网格数比经典HLLD少一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 通过放宽不可压缩假设，新多态HLL型近似解法可正确包含慢磁声波并显著降低数值耗散，提升MHD黎曼问题的求解效率。

title: Origin and Reduction of Coercive Fields in ZnO-based Wurtzite Ferroelectrics
summary: Wurtzite ferroelectrics offer a route to semiconductor-compatible non-volatile devices, but their large coercive fields (E$_c$) constrain the operating window between polarization reversal, leakage and dielectric breakdown. Atomically localized and non-classical switching fronts have recently been identified in wurtzite nitrides, yet the microscopic feature that sets the coercive field remains unresolved. Here we use large-scale reactive molecular dynamics, parameterized against first-principles data, to follow field-driven reversal in pristine, Mg-modified and heterostructured ZnO. Reversal proceeds through rugged inversion-boundary filaments in agreement with recent observations in other wurtzite ferroelectrics. We find that the field required for switching is controlled by the advancing filament head, which is a under-coordinated reconstructed inversion-boundary region during the transient switching dynamics with a large field-aligned local polar-order amplitude that is only partially compensated by an oppositely oriented surrounding shell. Controlled strain-only and charge-doping-only perturbations show that charge redistribution lowers the coercive field more effectively than strain because it suppresses this field-setting unscreened local polar order at the filament head, with the combined effect lowering E$_c$ by $\sim$ 50 \%. Layered ZnO/ZnMgO architectures further create buried nucleation sites and shorten filament propagation lengths. These results connect atomistic switching topology to a materials-design principle for substantially reducing coercive fields in ZnO-based wurtzite ferroelectrics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模反应分子动力学模拟研究ZnO基纤锌矿铁电体的场驱动翻转机制，发现矫顽场由翻转丝头部未屏蔽的局域极化序决定，通过电荷调控可将其降低约50%。
AI.motivation: 纤锌矿铁电体可实现半导体兼容的非易失器件，但其大矫顽场（Ec）限制了极化翻转、漏电与介电击穿之间的工作窗口。尽管已在纤锌矿氮化物中发现原子级局域和非经典翻转前沿，但决定矫顽场的微观特征仍未解决。
AI.method: 采用基于第一性原理数据参数化的大规模反应分子动力学模拟，追踪纯净、Mg修饰及异质结构ZnO中的场驱动极化翻转过程，并进行单纯应变与单纯电荷掺杂的对照扰动实验。
AI.result: 翻转通过崎岖的反转边界丝进行，与他人观察一致。翻转所需电场由前进的丝头部控制，该区域是欠配位重构的反转边界区域，具有大的场对准局域极序振幅，仅被反向取向的周围壳层部分补偿。电荷重分布比应变更有效降低矫顽场，因其抑制丝头部未屏蔽局域极序，联合效应使Ec降低约50%。层状ZnO/ZnMgO结构进一步产生埋入成核位点并缩短丝传播长度。
AI.conclusion: 研究将原子级翻转拓扑与材料设计原则相连接，为大幅降低ZnO基纤锌矿铁电体矫顽场提供方案。

title: Trajectory Statistics Govern Mechanical Power Transfer in Active Baths
summary: The mechanical response of a moving probe in an active bath reflects both the dynamics of the bath and how the probe couples to it. For a probe moving at velocity $\mathbf V$ and interacting weakly with an ideal active bath, we show that the trajectory statistics of a free bath particle determine a density response from which the bath force on the probe follows. The probe-particle interaction determines how this response is weighted over wave vector $\mathbf q$, while the probe motion selects frequencies $ω_{\mathbf q}=\mathbf q\cdot \mathbf V$. This trajectory-response relation separates the bath dynamics from the wave-vector weighting, so neither the stationary state nor force correlations need to be recalculated for each probe interaction and velocity. Applying this relation to active-particle models, we prove that positive power transfer is excluded for active Ornstein--Uhlenbeck particles in all dimensions and for complete-reset run-and-tumble particles in $d\geq2$, while one-dimensional run-and-tumble particles and two-dimensional active Brownian particles possess modes that can transfer positive mechanical power. For a given probe, this response predicts drag reversal, spontaneous probe motion, and motion-induced density distortions, all in quantitative agreement with simulations. Varying the probe geometry changes how the same bath response is weighted, thereby selecting different moving states. Beyond the leading weak-probe, ideal-bath limit, higher orders in probe strength involve multi-interval trajectory statistics, while finite-density corrections involve interacting-particle dynamics. Our results connect the trajectory statistics of active bath particles to the mechanical response of a passive probe, providing a route to predict probe response from single-particle trajectory statistics measured in the absence of the probe.

AI.tldr: 论文建立了活性浴中移动探针的力学响应与浴粒子轨迹统计之间的联系，发展出轨迹-响应关系，可预测拖曳反转、自发运动及密度畸变，并通过模拟验证。
AI.motivation: 移动探针在活性浴中的力学响应通常依赖探针-粒子相互作用与速度，计算需针对每种情形重做。作者希望找到一种将浴动力学与探针几何/运动解耦的通用关系，从而能由无探针时测得的单粒子轨迹统计直接预测探针响应。
AI.method: 针对弱探针、理想活性浴极限，推导探针所受浴力密度响应与自由浴粒子轨迹统计之间的关系；探针-粒子相互作用决定响应对波矢q的权重，探针运动选择频率ω=q·V。将该关系应用于多种活性粒子模型，并用模拟对比。
AI.result: 证明：活性Ornstein-Uhlenbeck粒子任意维度、完整重置run-and-tumble粒子d≥2时正功率传递被排除；一维run-and-tumble与二维active Brownian粒子存在可传递正机械功率的模式。预测出拖曳反转、自发探针运动及运动诱导密度畸变，与模拟定量吻合；改变探针几何可选择不同运动态。更强探针强度涉及多区间轨迹统计，有限密度修正涉及相互作用粒子动力学。
AI.conclusion: 结果将活性浴粒子的轨迹统计与被动探针的力学响应联系起来，提供了一条从无探针时测得的单粒子轨迹统计预测探针响应的途径。

title: Tailored coupled cluster method with sample-based quantum diagonalization: Application to titanium-based metallocene catalytic reactions for 1-hexene production
summary: Sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD) is a hybrid quantum-classical method for electronic-structure calculations. We applied SQD to a titanium-based metallocene catalyst system for 1-hexene production, where free-energy differences must be predicted within 1 kcal/mol to accurately determine product selectivity. However, currently accessible active spaces on quantum computers are limited in size, leaving significant dynamical correlation effects outside the active space. To address this challenge, we combined SQD with Tailored Coupled Cluster (TCC) theory. In this SQD-TCC framework, static correlation is treated by SQD, while dynamical correlation is incorporated through CCSD and its perturbative triples extension, TCC(T). We calculated the relative energies of two transition states governing 1-hexene selectivity. While SQD alone did not yield converged relative energies within practically accessible active spaces, SQD-TCC and SQD-TCC(T) provided reasonably converged results. Importantly, the relative energy obtained from SQD-TCC(T) differed by more than 1 kcal/mol from the corresponding CCSD(T) result, demonstrating the significance of static correlation in this system and its impact on predicted selectivity. Although TCC(T) calculations based on CASCI are feasible for small active spaces, the present system requires substantially larger active spaces that are beyond the reach of CASCI. By using SQD, we were able to access active spaces impractical for classical CASCI calculations. These results demonstrate that both static and dynamical electron correlation are essential for a reliable description of this chemistry and highlight the importance of incorporating dynamical correlation into quantum-computing approaches targeting chemically accurate simulations.

AI.tldr: 该论文将采样量子对角化(SQD)与定制耦合簇(TCC)理论结合，用于钛基金属茂催化剂体系，展示了静/动电子相关对化学精度模拟的重要性。
AI.motivation: 量子计算机上可访问的活性空间有限，导致大量动态相关效应被排除在外；而对1-己烯选择性的准确预测需在1 kcal/mol内预测自由能差。
AI.method: 提出SQD-TCC框架：静相关由SQD处理，动态相关通过CCSD及其微扰三体扩展TCC(T)引入。计算控制选择性的两个过渡态的相对能量。
AI.result: SQD单独在可及活性空间内未能收敛；SQD-TCC与SQD-TCC(T)得到合理收敛结果。SQD-TCC(T)的相对能量与CCSD(T)相差超过1 kcal/mol，体现静相关的重要性。SQD使活性空间超出CASCI的经典计算能力。
AI.conclusion: 静相关与动态相关对此化学体系均不可或缺；强调在面向化学精度模拟的量子计算方法中纳入动态相关的重要性。

title: 1/f frequency noise in mechanical resonators scales inversely with volume, not with quality factor
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, Supplemental Material also provided
summary: Mechanical frequency-shift sensors have never reached their fundamental thermomechanical or quantum limits. Every material, size, and transduction scheme yet examined yields a $1/f$ floor 1-3 orders higher, with a flicker-noise coefficient $h_{-1} \propto 1/V_{\varepsilon}$. Surveying the published record, I find the invariant $h_{-1}\,V_{\varepsilon} \equiv σ_A ^2\, V_{\varepsilon}/(2\ln 2)$ independent of device size across 13 decades; volume-independent noise is excluded by 9$σ$, site-averaging by 3.8$σ$. No $Q$ dependence appears: reported $Q^{-n}$ laws scale equivalently when $Q$ and volume co-vary; only volume scaling survives when they do not. Mass resolution follows as $|δm| \propto \sqrt{h_{-1}\,V_{\varepsilon} \cdot V}$.

AI.tldr: 本文综述机械频移传感器的 flicker 噪声，发现不变量 h₋₁Vε 与器件尺寸无关，跨越13个数量级，并推导出质量分辨率公式。
AI.motivation: 机械频移传感器在热机械或量子极限方面尚未达到其基本极限，所有材料、尺寸和换能方案均存在比基本极限高1-3个数量级的 1/f 噪声底，即 flicker 噪声系数 h₋₁ ∝ 1/Vε，缺乏统一的理解。
AI.method: 调研已发表数据，分析 flicker 噪声系数 h₋₁ 与有效体积 Vε 的关系，检验不变量 h₋₁Vε、体积无关噪声假设及 Q 依赖性。
AI.result: 发现不变量 h₋₁Vε ≡ σ_A²Vε/(2ln2) 与器件尺寸无关，跨越13个数量级；体积无关噪声被 9σ 排除，位点平均被 3.8σ 排除；未出现 Q 依赖性，已报道的 Q⁻ⁿ 律在 Q 与体积协变时等效缩放，仅体积缩放独立成立。质量分辨率满足 |δm| ∝ √(h₋₁Vε·V)。
AI.conclusion: 机械频移传感器的噪声受一个与体积相关的不变量支配，独立于 Q 因子，由此给出统一的质量分辨率标度律，为达到基本极限提供指导。

title: Interplay of dimerization and quasiperiodicity in the superconducting proximity effect of a one-dimensional hybrid ring
summary: Recent studies of the superconducting proximity effect in quasicrystalline and topological systems have opened up a new research direction for exploring how quasiperiodicity and topology influence proximity induced superconductivity.
